China also added approximately 25.8 tonnes to its official gold reserves in October—the largest monthly addition in three years.

👀 NEXT: US CPI tomorrow at 8:30 a.m. ET.
A cooler reading could support the rebound. A hotter print could revive pressure from the dollar and interest-rate expectations.

My take: CPI can move metals in minutes. Bringing new mines into production takes years.

Follow @Swedish_Uranium for the daily pulse.
